prompt_used:
I want to become a any type of role (software engineering). I have 3 months to prepare and I can study 3 hours per day. 
My experience level is University Final Year CSE Student. Need remote job, prefer flutter development., Intermediate (Built small projects), familiar with python,Java,C languages and familiar with React framework. Also build some academic projects.
Now generate a learning plan for me.

generated_plan.plan_title: 3-Month Remote Flutter Software Engineering Learning Plan

months.focus: Flutter & Dart Fundamentals, Core UI & API Integration

topics: Dart Language Fundamentals (syntax, OOP, async/await, collections)
Flutter Environment Setup & Widgets (StatelessWidget, StatefulWidget, Material Design)
Basic Layout Widgets (Container, Row, Column, Text, Image, Button)
activities: Complete official Dart language tour & Flutter 'Write your first Flutter app' tutorial.
Build 3-4 simple static UI screens (e.g., login screen, product card, profile view).
Familiarize with VS Code/Android Studio for Flutter development.

topics: Advanced Layout Widgets (Stack, Expanded, Flexible, Wrap, GridView, ListView)
Navigation (Navigator 1.0 & 2.0 basics, named routes)
User Input & Forms (TextField, Checkbox, Radio, Form validation)
activities: Create a multi-screen application with navigation between different routes.
Implement a user registration/login form with basic input validation.
Practice creating complex layouts by replicating designs from Dribbble/Behance.

topics: Data Persistence (shared_preferences, Hive/sqflite basics)
Networking (http/dio package, making GET/POST requests)
JSON Parsing & Model Generation
Asynchronous UI (FutureBuilder, StreamBuilder)
activities: Integrate with a public REST API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap, PokeAPI, Fake Store API) to fetch and display data.
Implement local data caching for fetched API data using shared_preferences or Hive.
Build a small app that shows a list of items fetched from an API.

topics: Introduction to State Management (setState vs lifting state up)
Provider package (basic concepts, Consumer, Selector)
Version Control with Git & GitHub (review advanced features: branching, merging, PRs)
activities: Refactor one of your previous apps to use the Provider package for state management.
Ensure all your code is consistently pushed to a public GitHub repository.
Participate in a small open-source Flutter project or contribute to a friend's project.

months.focus: Advanced State Management, Backend Integration, DSA & Testing

topics: Advanced State Management (Deep dive into Bloc/Cubit or Riverpod - choose one primary, understand others conceptually)
Dependency Injection
Error Handling & Loading States with chosen state management solution
activities: Re-architect a previous app using your chosen advanced state management solution (Bloc/Riverpod).
Build a new moderately complex feature (e.g., pagination, search functionality) using the chosen state management.
Focus on clean architecture principles (separation of concerns).

topics: Firebase Integration (Authentication with Email/Google/Social login)
Cloud Firestore/Realtime Database (CRUD operations, querying)
Firebase Storage (uploading/downloading files)
Push Notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging - FCM basics)
activities: Build a simple chat application or a social media feed with user authentication and real-time data using Firebase.
Implement file upload functionality (e.g., user profile picture) to Firebase Storage.
Experiment with sending basic push notifications.

topics: Testing in Flutter (Unit Testing, Widget Testing)
Mocking dependencies for tests
Debugging techniques and tools in Flutter
Introduction to Integration Testing
activities: Write comprehensive unit tests for your data models and business logic.
Develop widget tests for key UI components in your projects.
Learn to use the Flutter DevTools effectively for performance analysis and debugging.

topics: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) Refresher (Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees, Hash Maps)
Time and Space Complexity Analysis
Common interview patterns (Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Recursion)
activities: Dedicate 1 hour daily to solving LeetCode/HackerRank problems (focus on Easy/Medium).
Review core DSA concepts using your university notes or online resources.
Practice explaining your thought process for solving problems out loud.

months.focus: Portfolio Project, Interview Preparation & Job Applications

topics: Portfolio Project Development (Phase 1: Core Features)
Clean Architecture principles (e.g., Domain Driven Design, BLoC/Cubit pattern)
Advanced UI/UX (Custom Painters, Animations, responsive design)
activities: Start building a substantial portfolio project (e.g., e-commerce app, task manager, social networking clone) that incorporates all learned skills.
Focus on robust architecture, maintainability, and a polished user interface.
Document your project's architecture and key features in a README file.

topics: Portfolio Project Development (Phase 2: Refinements, Testing, Deployment)
Advanced DSA topics (Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Greedy Algorithms - focus on frequently asked)
Performance Optimization in Flutter
activities: Complete core features, add comprehensive tests (unit, widget, integration where applicable) to your portfolio project.
Deploy your Flutter app to a platform (e.g., Web, Firebase Hosting, even a simple APK for Android).
Continue DSA practice, dedicating 1 hour daily to Medium/Hard problems.
Optimize app performance (e.g., avoiding unnecessary rebuilds, image caching).

topics: Resume & Cover Letter Crafting (tailoring for remote Flutter roles)
Technical Interview Preparation (Flutter specific, DSA, System Design basics)
Behavioral Interview Preparation (STAR method, common questions)
activities: Create a polished resume highlighting your Flutter projects, academic experience, and skills.
Write a compelling cover letter template for remote Flutter development roles.
Practice mock interviews (technical & behavioral) with peers or mentors.
Review common Flutter interview questions (widgets lifecycle, state management, async in Dart).

topics: Job Application Strategies (LinkedIn, Remote job boards, networking)
Portfolio Showcase (GitHub README, live demo, personal website if applicable)
Continuous Learning & Feedback Loop
activities: Actively start applying to remote Flutter/Software Engineering roles.
Network with professionals on LinkedIn, participate in relevant online communities.
Refine your application materials based on feedback and interview experiences.
Continue building small projects or contributing to open source in your spare time.

general_recommendations: Consistency is key: Stick to your 3 hours per day schedule.
Active learning: Don't just watch tutorials; build, break, and fix things.
Utilize official documentation: Flutter's documentation and Codelabs are excellent.
Join communities: Engage with the Flutter community on Discord, Reddit, or Stack Overflow.
GitHub Profile: Maintain an active GitHub profile with well-documented projects.
Soft Skills: Practice communication, teamwork, and problem-solving, as they are crucial for remote roles.
Networking: Connect with other developers and recruiters on LinkedIn.

flutter_dart_learning: Angela Yu's 'The Complete 2023 Flutter Development Bootcamp' (Udemy)
Max Schwarzmüller's 'Flutter & Dart - The Complete Guide' (Udemy)
